model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k), with the x-axis representing the number of completions on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, and the y-axis showing coverage values from 0.4 to 0.8. Four distinct lines are plotted: Llama-3B (blue circles, solid line), Llama-3B + FT (green triangles, solid line), Llama-1B (purple squares, dashed line), and Llama-1B + FT (light blue diamonds, dashed line). Coverage increases with the number of completions for all models, with Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT achieving higher coverage than Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT across the entire range. The Llama-3B + FT model reaches the highest coverage, approaching 0.8 at 2⁸ completions, while Llama-3B reaches approximately 0.78. Llama-1B + FT reaches about 0.72 at 2⁸, and Llama-1B reaches approximately 0.68. All models show a consistent upward trend, with Llama-3B + FT consistently outperforming Llama-3B, and Llama-1B + FT outperforming Llama-1B.
